16: # Basic results on finitely generated (sub)modules
17: 
18: This file contains the basic results on `Submodule.FG` and `Module.Finite` that do not need heavy
19: further imports.

30: variable {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]

32: open Set
33: 
34: theorem fg_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R M).FG :=
35:   ⟨∅, by rw [Finset.coe_empty, span_empty]⟩
36: 
37: theorem fg_span {s : Set M} (hs : s.Finite) : FG (span R s) :=
38:   ⟨hs.toFinset, by rw [hs.coe_toFinset]⟩
39: 
40: theorem fg_span_singleton (x : M) : FG (R ∙ x) :=
41:   fg_span (finite_singleton x)
42: 
43: theorem FG.sup {N₁ N₂ : Submodule R M} (hN₁ : N₁.FG) (hN₂ : N₂.FG) : (N₁ ⊔ N₂).FG :=
44:   let ⟨t₁, ht₁, span_t₁⟩ := fg_def.mp hN₁
45:   let ⟨t₂, ht₂, span_t₂⟩ := fg_def.mp hN₂
46:   fg_def.mpr ⟨t₁ ∪ t₂, ht₁.union ht₂, by rw [span_union, span_t₁, span_t₂]⟩
47: 
48: theorem fg_finset_sup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (N : ι → Submodule R M) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (N i).FG) :
49:     (s.sup N).FG :=
50:   Finset.sup_induction fg_bot (fun _ ha _ hb => ha.sup hb) h
51: 
52: theorem fg_biSup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (N : ι → Submodule R M) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (N i).FG) :
53:     (⨆ i ∈ s, N i).FG := by simpa only [Finset.sup_eq_iSup] using fg_finset_sup s N h
54: 
55: theorem fg_iSup {ι : Sort*} [Finite ι] (N : ι → Submodule R M) (h : ∀ i, (N i).FG) :
56:     (iSup N).FG := by
57:   cases nonempty_fintype (PLift ι)
58:   simpa [iSup_plift_down] using fg_biSup Finset.univ (N ∘ PLift.down) fun i _ => h i.down
59: 
60: instance : SemilatticeSup {P : Submodule R M // P.FG} where
61:   sup := fun P Q ↦ ⟨P.val ⊔ Q.val, Submodule.FG.sup P.property Q.property⟩
62:   le_sup_left := fun P Q ↦ by rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe]; exact le_sup_left
63:   le_sup_right := fun P Q ↦ by rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe]; exact le_sup_right
64:   sup_le := fun P Q R hPR hQR ↦ by
65:     rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe] at hPR hQR ⊢
66:     exact sup_le hPR hQR

68: instance : Inhabited {P : Submodule R M // P.FG} where

76: theorem fg_pi {ι : Type*} {M : ι → Type*} [Finite ι] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)]
77:     [∀ i, Module R (M i)] {p : ∀ i, Submodule R (M i)} (hsb : ∀ i, (p i).FG) :
78:     (pi Set.univ p).FG := by
79:   classical
80:     simp_rw [fg_def] at hsb ⊢
81:     choose t htf hts using hsb
82:     refine
83:       ⟨⋃ i, (LinearMap.single R _ i) '' t i, Set.finite_iUnion fun i => (htf i).image _, ?_⟩
84:     -- Note: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/8386 changed `span_image` into `span_image _`
85:     simp_rw [span_iUnion, span_image _, hts, iSup_map_single]

87: theorem FG.map {N : Submodule R M} (hs : N.FG) : (N.map f).FG :=
88:   let ⟨t, ht, span_t⟩ := fg_def.mp hs
89:   fg_def.mpr ⟨f '' t, ht.image _, by rw [span_image, span_t]⟩

92: @[simp] lemma fg_range [Module.Finite R M] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] P) : f.range.FG := by
93:   rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map]
94:   exact Module.Finite.fg_top.map f
